output.reason: The evidence states that the “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans (2014)” was withdrawn/repealed by the “Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025” effective from 2026-01-01, and further indicates that the Directions, 2025 were withdrawn with effect from 2025-11-28 such that on 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force. Therefore, the earlier (2014) floating-rate term-loan directions are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
